name: muster
description: Shared operational memory for long-lived agents: who is on duty, who owns what, what rotted and what needs a human.

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB Atlas connection string. Use a cluster in the same region as the dyno.

BASE_URL.description: Public origin. Every generated URL and every agent-facing file is built from this, so it must match what agents resolve.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Sends the six digit code for the human claim step. Without it, codes go to the log.
